descriptor: Unique identifier for each image, assigned by camera at time of capture (e.g. IMG_1643).
Date of image capture. All sampling conducted over three consecutive days in April 2024.
Named section within the farm. Each section contains multiple tanks sharing a common pump shed.
Individual grow-out tank identifier. Multiple abalone sampled per tank
Sequential identifier of each abalone sampled within a tank. Used together with tank to construct a unique abalone_id.
Approximate age of abalone at time of sampling in months.
Numerical identifier assigned to each diet to anonymous commercial supplier.
Shade cloth classification directly above abalone. Single = one layer; double = two layers.
Maximum shell length of the abalone measured using python script "abalone_morphometrics"
Maximum shell width measured using python script "abalone_morphometrics"
Projected shell area measured using python script "abalone_morphometrics"
Abalone weight. Derived from length using a pre-established weight-length relationship W =0.000102572*L^3.05321

Raw L* value extracted from the abalone lip in Fiji using the CIELAB colour model, prior to colour card correction. L* = 0 (black) to 100 (white). Data extracted using Macro script "colour_components".
Raw a* value extracted from the lip in Fiji using the CIELAB colour model, prior to colour card correction. a* = -128 (green) to 128 (red). Data extracted using Macro script "colour_components".
Raw b* value extracted from the lip in Fiji using the CIELAB colour model. b* = -128 (blue) to 128 (yellow). Data extracted using Macro script "colour_components".

Slope of the linear regression between observed L* values of the colour calibration card and their known reference L* values. Used to correct raw L* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
Intercept of the linear regression for L* colour calibration. Used to correct raw L* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
R² of the L* calibration regression. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".

Slope of the linear regression between observed a* values of the colour calibration card  and their known reference a* values. Used to correct raw a* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
Intercept of the linear regression for a* colour calibration. Used to correct raw a* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
R² of the a* calibration regression. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".

Slope of the linear regression between observed b* values of the colour calibration card  and their known reference b* values. Used to correct raw b* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
Intercept of the linear regression for b* colour calibration. Used to correct raw b* measurements. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
R² of the b* calibration regression. Calibration performed using Python script "colour_correction_factors".
Calibration-corrected L* value used in modelling. Derived by applying the per-image L* regression (L_slope, L_intercept) to the raw L* measurement. Higher values indicate lighter abalone.
Calibration-corrected a* value used in modelling. Derived by applying the per-image a* regression to the raw a* measurement. Higher a* values indicate more red abalone.
Calibration-corrected b* value used in modelling. Derived by applying the per-image b* regression to the raw b* measurement. Higher b* values indicate more yellow abalone.
Measure of colour intensity calculated from sqrt((a*^2) + (b*^2)
